preamble: Chapter rule 1: Fish, crustaceans, molluscs and other aquatic invertebrates shall be deemed originating even if they were cultivated from nonoriginating fry or larvae. For purposes of this rule, the term “fry” means immature fish at a post-larval stage and includes fingerlings, parr, smolts and elvers.

rules.text: A change to headings 0301 through 0308 from any other chapter.
